text:
maria (People Ops): Posting the end-to-end timeline for this cycle so teams can plan: Self-assessments open today and close Fri Jun 4 23:59 PT. Manager calibration window: Jun 7-11. Final manager submissions due by Mon Jun 14.

ben (Eng Manager): thanks! Will managers get a scoring template or is it embedded in the form?

maria (People Ops): There's a separate scoring sheet with the updated rubric (link in guide): https://redwood.app/docs/perf-2026/manager-tools. Download, fill, then upload the final CSV when you submit.

tara (IC): If someone is on a short-term rotation away during calibration week, do they get rated?

maria (People Ops): Rotation <30 days = no formal rating; add ramp/rotation notes in the "Context for Calibration" field so the hiring/managering team has visibility.

nina (Recruiting): Hiring ops asks for a required "Ramp Plan" field on the manager form. Can we enforce that?

maria (People Ops): Added it as a required field for hires <90 days; for others it's optional. Keep it 2-3 bullet points.

ben (Eng Manager): Extension policy — can managers grant more than 3 business days? We had a long medical case last year.

maria (People Ops): Max standard extension is 3 business days. For longer accommodations contact pplops directly for an exceptions review (HR-led). Use this form: https://redwood.app/forms/perf-exception.

peopleops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Manager calibration week starts in 2 days" will post in #people-ops and team channels.

ben (Eng Manager): How do appeals work if a manager thinks a calibrated rating is incorrect?

maria (People Ops): Managers can request recalibration within 3 business days via the recalibration form (link in guide). If escalated, directors will run a secondary calibration with documentation. IC appeals follow the formal HR appeals path.

srini (Director): I'll host two optional calibration office hours Jun 8 at 9am PT and Jun 10 at 4pm PT for tricky cases. Please bring scoring sheet and 2 example datapoints.

maria (People Ops): Manager invite template (copy/paste):

````
Subject: Calibration Team {NAME}
Agenda: 1) Context (5m) 2) Borderline/edge cases (50m) 3) Finalize ratings + notes (25m)
Prep: scoring sheet, examples, links to PRs/dashboards
````

ben (Eng Manager): filed one extension for an engineer out sick; thanks for fast-track.

maria (People Ops): Got it Ben 44d. We'll confirm by EOD tomorrow.

tara (IC): Where's the self-assessment template? I keep losing the link.

maria (People Ops): Docs -> Performance Guide -> Self-Assessment Template. TL;DR: 3 bullets (what worked), 1 short example with metric, 1 dev goal (~200-300 words).

peopleops-bot: After manager submit, autogenerated summary emails (rating + manager comments) will be sent to direct reports within 72 business hours.

maria (People Ops): Final note: keep calibration notes factual and concise for auditability. DM me for exceptions or questions. :wave:
